Title is "Tunnels of Blood" (the metadata string "Cirque Du Freak 03 - Tunnels of Blood" is series padding, not the canonical title). Author Darren Shan confirmed. It is a real numbered volume: book 3 of the 12-book saga, published in the UK by HarperCollins as "The Saga of Darren Shan" and in the US by Little, Brown as "Cirque Du Freak: The Saga of Darren Shan" — I recorded the widely used series name "Cirque du Freak" (identical series, alternate regional title). Books 1-3 were also bundled as the "Vampire Blood Trilogy" omnibus, but that is a collection rather than the numbering scheme for this volume.
